title: UI packs
description: A UI pack standardises the terminal UI: tokens (sizes, glyphs, styles), a fixed catalogue of widgets arranged into screens, key bindings with their hints, and the UI's own words. Every field defaults to the standard look, so a UI pack only writes what it changes. The engine owns the catalogue: screens, widgets and where each may appear, input actions, hint contexts and style roles.

manifest.description: A UI pack's manifest (ui.json). A UI pack is shared by game packs; it owns the look, layout, keys and the UI's words.

engine.description: Words the widgets use. Placeholders in braces are filled in; each word may use only its own. A missing word shows as its key.

go_to.description: Menu label for an exit without a label of its own. Placeholders: {destination}.

talk.description: Menu label for talking to someone. No placeholders.

inspect.description: Menu label for looking closely. No placeholders.

fit.description: Board: fit a frame, module or implant. No placeholders.

remove.description: Board: remove a worn or fitted item. No placeholders.

store.description: Board: put an item into storage within reach. No placeholders.

take.description: Board: take a stored item. No placeholders.

dismantle.description: Board: dismantle an item at a workshop. No placeholders.

repair.description: Board: repair a worn item. No placeholders.

fabricate.description: Board: make a copy of a known design. No placeholders.

pack_fitted.description: Board heading: worn and fitted items. No placeholders.

pack_carried.description: Board heading: carried items. No placeholders.

pack_stored.description: Board heading: storage within reach. Placeholders: {container}.

pack_designs.description: Board heading: known designs, near a fabricating workshop. No placeholders.

day_phase.description: Status: the day and part of the day. Placeholders: {day}, {phase}.

party.description: Status: who travels with the player. Placeholders: {names}.

encounter_round.description: Encounter title with the round about to be played. Placeholders: {encounter}, {round}.

round_log.description: Log heading: the round just played. Placeholders: {round}.

terminal_too_small.description: Shown instead of the game when the terminal is too small. Placeholders: {columns}, {rows}.

entries.description: Hint labels, referred to by id from keys.json.

zone.description: One bordered band of a screen.

priority.description: When the screen doesn't fit the terminal, zones with the highest priority are dropped first; 0 is never dropped.

hide_when_empty.description: Draw nothing, not even the border, when the zone has nothing to show.

layout.description: What a zone holds: one widget, two side by side, or several one after another.

oneOf.description: Two layouts side by side, divided by a line.

fixed.description: The side that keeps its natural width; the other takes the rest.

oneOf.description: Layouts one after another in the same zone; empty ones take no space.

hint.description: One key hint: the keys of some actions (or 1-9), then a label.

actions.description: Actions whose keys are shown, joined, e.g. WASD.

digits.description: Show '1-9' (the number keys) instead of action keys.

label.description: Id of a text in the words file.

style.description: How text in one role looks.

widget_title.description: The screen's title line: the location and region with hazards, the encounter and its round, or the fight's result. Allowed on: world, encounter, debrief.

widget_grid.description: The room: tiles, objects, characters and the player. Allowed on: world.

widget_status.description: Day and phase, pool bars, statuses and party. Allowed on: world.

pools.description: Which pool stats show as bars: 'all', or a list of stat roles in order.

party.description: List who travels with the player.

widget_legend.description: What each glyph on the grid is. Allowed on: world.

widget_log.description: Messages, in the order they happened. Allowed on: world, encounter, debrief.

round_heading.description: In fights, head the log with the round it describes.

widget_menu.description: What can be done with the thing in focus. Allowed on: world.

hints.description: Show why unavailable options can't be used.

widget_choice.description: A choice waiting for an answer. Allowed on: world, encounter.

hints.description: Show why unavailable options can't be picked.

widget_board.description: The fitting board: budgets, items by where they are, the picked item's options. Allowed on: world.

budgets.description: Show the power, mass and cargo line.

widget_sheet.description: The character sheet: skills with experience, and stats. Allowed on: world.

widget_tiles.description: The player's action tiles. Allowed on: encounter.

widget_fighters.description: Both sides with health bars, and the enemies' intents. Allowed on: encounter.

widget_art.description: The picture of the enemy in front. Allowed on: encounter.

widget_keys.description: The key hints for the current context, built from the key bindings. Allowed on: world, encounter, debrief.
